# Public interview: actual app output

`demo.mp4` and `poster.webp` show Texter processing a publicly released interview. They are screen recordings of the app, not the source video.

Source: "シティキャストインタビュー（第3回）", published by the YouTube channel "スポーツTOKYOインフォメーション" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0-a_Ad_jYHA). YouTube lists the video under the Creative Commons Attribution license (reuse allowed). The license shown on YouTube was checked on 2026-11-12. Duration: 49 minutes 5 seconds. One interviewer and three guests.

The audio track was imported without editing into Texter development version 2.11.73 on an iPhone 12 Pro running iOS 26.6.1. Cloud speech recognition was used with Japanese selected, speaker identification on, and the number of speakers set to five. No custom vocabulary was registered.

The screen recording was taken on the device on 2026-11-12. It was edited: unrelated parts were cut (including the wait between completion and opening the note), a development-only row on the import screen is blurred, frames showing development-only text were removed, the waiting time is shown at 4x speed, and other notes in the list are blurred. It has no audio. The text shown in the recording and quoted in the guide is Texter's unedited output. It was not produced or reviewed by the source's publisher. The full transcript is not published here.

This is one measurement of one recording, made with a development build; the App Store build was not tested. It does not establish accuracy or processing speed for other recordings, devices, networks, or versions. The output was not compared against the audio in full.
